units.source_text: 我们站在这小桥上，毫无意义地凝望着水面。

en.t: We stood on this little bridge, gazing meaninglessly at the surface of the water.

units.source_text: 战争期间的种种回忆中，这样短暂而无意义的时间却留下了鲜明的印象。

en.t: Among all my memories of the war years, moments as brief and meaningless as this left a vivid impression.

units.source_text: 茫然若失的短暂时间，就像偶尔从云隙露出的晴空那样处处可见。

en.t: Such brief moments of vacant bewilderment could be seen everywhere, like clear sky occasionally showing through gaps in the clouds.

units.source_text: 这种时间，活似痛切的快乐回忆，非常新鲜，这是难以想像的。

en.t: It is hard to imagine how fresh such moments were, almost like intensely painful memories of happiness.
